messages:
kate (Acme Integrations): hey team, onboarding with sdkgateway. after we rotated our service key earlier today, our requests are getting 401s with 'signature mismatch'. we've pinned the client to the new key and still failing. example curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Signature: sha256=..." https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate` Any tips?

jess (CSM): thanks kate — looping in eng. rough check: started immediately after rotation and all calls fail for the same client id?

kate (Acme Integrations): yes, every call from the web worker stack. other customers seem fine.

sam (sdkgateway): ping. can you paste the full `X-Signature` header (redact secret) and the raw body or canonical string? common causes: encoding mismatch, timestamp difference, or URL canonicalization. also, did you rotate server-side and not restart the signing service?

kate (Acme Integrations): here's sanitized header and body (sanitized):
```
X-Signature: sha256=ab12cdef...
body: {"prompt":"hi"}
Timestamp: 1700000000
```

sam (sdkgateway): two quick things — (1) check whether your client library does `Buffer.from(str).toString('hex')` vs `base64` — we expect hex for our HMAC. (2) verify newline handling; our canonicalization strips trailing newlines. can you run this on your machine:
```
echo -n '{"prompt":"hi"}' | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac 'YOUR_KEY' | sed 's/^.* //'
```
should match the hex after `sha256=`.

kate (Acme Integrations): running now... getting `ab12cdf...` (different by first 4 chars)

mike (eng-infra): adding another angle — clock skew. our auth window is +-120s; our server checks timestamp in seconds. if your timestamp header uses ms vs s or an offset it will break. kate: what is the timestamp format you send?

kate (Acme Integrations): we send JS Date.now() / 1000 (rounded). may be a math bug in one worker.

sam (sdkgateway): also check URL encoding for query params — our signature expects sorted query string. are you signing the full url or just path+query?

kate (Acme Integrations): just signing path+query.

sam (sdkgateway): good. can you run the openssl test with the same timestamp and path? if mismatch persists paste the hex and I'll compare.

kate (Acme Integrations): run again with timestamp as integer seconds and hex matched! looks like the division by 1000 was rounding odd in one worker. thanks!

jess (CSM): awesome — do you want us to push a short KB so others don't trip on Date.now()/1000 vs floor? also, any rate-limit noise from retries?

kate (Acme Integrations): no rate limits. only signature. minor deploy impact earlier; we're back.

sam (sdkgateway): we'll put a note in sdkgateway FAQ. I'll follow up with a quick PR to the node SDK to normalize timestamp output (Math.floor(Date.now()/1000)).

ci-bot: deploy queued — sdkgateway/docs#224

jess (CSM): tagging for closure. @kate, we'll check in next week to confirm renewal readiness — glad this was quick.

kate (Acme Integrations): thanks all :thumbsup:
